title: Real Wedding Prices, Checked: Rachel's List Guides
description: Courthouse fees, small wedding venues and designer gowns with real prices, each checked on its source page. Last checked Oct 28, 2026.
refresh_note: Pages refresh weekly, monthly or every 3 months; each shows its own date.
answer_html: As of Oct 28, 2026: 20 secondhand designer gowns are $500 or less. Every number links to the page it came from and shows the day we read it.
oneliner: Real wedding prices for five US cities, each checked on its source page and dated Oct 28, 2026.
facts_intro: The official license fee and the cheapest small-venue price we could verify on a venue's own site. Open a city for every row, quote and date.
ideas_lead: Whatever the venue, the rest of the day can cost less too. One real find in each category, from its own page and dated.

faq.q: How much does a small wedding cost?
faq.a: It depends on the city and the venue, so we do not quote an average. Open a city page to see the actual fees and the small-venue prices we verified on venues' own websites.

faq.q: Are courthouse weddings cheaper than a venue?
faq.a: The official fees are listed on each courthouse page with the county's own wording. Compare them with the venue prices on the same city's venue page: both show the day we read them.

faq.q: Can I really find a designer wedding dress for under $500?
faq.a: Yes: we re-open secondhand designer listings every Tuesday and show only the ones still available. See the dress pages for this week's gowns and their sellers' original prices.
Rachel's List, a free wedding-planning app that finds dresses, decor and venues for less. We earn nothing from the venues, sellers or photographers listed.

faq.q: How do you check a price?
faq.a: Official pages are quoted word for word, venue prices come from the venue's own site, and dress listings are re-opened before they appear. Read how we check.
